'''R4-T1''' was an [[R4 astromech droid/Legends|R4-series astromech droid]] in the service of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

R4-T1 was one of the more basic R4 [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromechs]] on the market, but still considered to be one of the most reliable.

==Behind the scenes==
R4-T1 was a pet [[Droid/Legends|droid]] which was made available for the in-game marketplace of [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] in [[December]], [[2013]] for the price of 4,999 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Republic Credits]].
